correctness.rationale: Every integral square signed circulation vanishes; the two rim windings agree. A winding w exists exactly when w has the prescribed parity and 5|w|<=n. The annular cycle-space relation makes signed cochain differences exact; height inequalities and a finite source-raising sequence prove all nonextreme colorings with the same w connected. For strict windings a directed cycle would have length L=5|w||m|<n|m|<=L; hence orientations are acyclic. Extreme windings force uniform horizontal and vertical signs, giving exactly ten isolated colorings per sign. Fujii et al. arXiv:2408.04802, Theorem 5.1 gives circle homotopy type for each acyclic component. Exhaustive standard-library checks for n=3..10 independently confirm components and cubical Euler characteristics. This proof does not use finite enumeration to infer the all-n theorem.
